requirements.text: When the user accesses the application, the system shall display a form with the following fields and elements: an input field for 'Event Name' with data-testid 'eventname', an input field for 'Person Name' with data-testid 'name', an input field for 'Designation' with data-testid 'designation', an input field for 'Company Name' with data-testid 'company', and a select dropdown for 'Access Level' with data-testid 'access'. Each of these fields is required. Additionally, a 'Generate Badge' button with data-testid 'generate-badge-button' shall be visible. The form, identified by data-testid 'badgeForm', must be fully accessible and visible on all screen sizes, ensuring that all fields and the button are accessible without horizontal scrolling on small screen devices.

The web application shall provide a form within a container identified by data-testid 'formContainer' for generating badges. The form, identified by data-testid 'badgeForm', shall include input fields for 'Event Name', 'Person Name', 'Designation', and 'Company Name', each with corresponding data-testids 'eventname', 'name', 'designation', and 'company'. Additionally, a dropdown for 'Access Level' with data-testid 'access' shall be present, offering options 'Attendee' and 'VIP'. All fields are required for form submission. Upon clicking the submit button with data-testid 'generate-badge-button', if all fields are correctly filled, the form container shall be hidden, and a badge container with data-testid 'badge' shall be displayed, showing the entered details. A QR code shall be generated within the badge, containing the user's ID and entered information. The 'Download Badge' button with data-testid 'dwnBadge' shall become visible, allowing the user to download the badge as a PNG image. If any field is left empty, the form shall remain visible, and the badge and download button shall not be displayed.

The web application shall provide a badge generation feature where users can input details including Event Name, Person Name, Designation, Company Name, and Access Level through a form. The form fields are identified by data-testid attributes: 'eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company', and 'access'. Upon clicking the 'Generate Badge' button (data-testid: 'generate-badge-button'), the form (data-testid: 'formContainer') shall be hidden, and a badge (data-testid: 'badge') shall be displayed. The badge will dynamically update to show the entered Event Name (data-testid: 'badgeEvent'), Person Name (data-testid: 'badgeName'), Designation (data-testid: 'badgeDesignation'), Company Name prefixed with '@' (data-testid: 'badgecontainer'), and Access Level (data-testid: 'badgeAccess'). Additionally, a QR code will be generated within the badge (data-testid: 'qrcode') containing the badge details. The 'Download Badge' button (data-testid: 'dwnBadge') will be enabled to allow users to download the badge as a PNG image. The system shall handle both normal and edge cases, including minimum input lengths for each field.

Upon form submission on the Badge Generator page, the system shall generate a unique ID for each badge. The user must provide inputs for Event Name, Person Name, Designation, Company Name, and select an Access Level from the dropdown options ('Attendee' or 'VIP'). These inputs, along with the generated unique ID, shall be embedded within a QR code displayed on the badge. The badge and QR code are shown in the designated badge area with data-testid 'badge' and 'qrcode', respectively. The form submission hides the form container with data-testid 'formContainer' and displays the badge container. The QR code text format should be 'ID: IDxxxx
Event: [Event Name]
Name: [Person Name]
Designation: [Designation]
Company: @[Company Name]
Access: [Access Level]'. Additionally, a 'Download Badge' button with data-testid 'dwnBadge' is displayed, allowing users to download the badge as a PNG image. The download functionality uses the html-to-image library to convert the badge HTML element into an image file.

The system shall display a 'Download Badge' button with the data-testid 'dwnBadge' after the user successfully generates a badge by submitting the form with all required fields: 'Event Name' (data-testid 'eventname'), 'Person Name' (data-testid 'name'), 'Designation' (data-testid 'designation'), 'Company Name' (data-testid 'company'), and 'Access Level' (data-testid 'access'). Upon clicking the 'Generate Badge' button (data-testid 'generate-badge-button'), the form container (data-testid 'formContainer') should be hidden, and the badge details should be displayed in the badge section (data-testid 'badge'). The badge should include a QR code (data-testid 'qrcode') generated with the user's details. The 'Download Badge' button should become visible, allowing the user to download the badge as a PNG image when clicked. The download process should create a link element, set its 'href' attribute to the generated image data URL, and trigger a click event to initiate the download.

The system shall allow users to generate and download a badge as a PNG image. When the user fills out the badge form with fields for 'Event Name', 'Person Name', 'Designation', 'Company Name', and 'Access Level', and submits the form by clicking the 'Generate Badge' button (data-testid: 'generate-badge-button'), the badge is displayed with the entered details. The badge includes a QR code generated with the user's information. Upon clicking the 'Download Badge' button (data-testid: 'dwnBadge'), the system shall convert the visible badge, including the QR code, to a PNG image and initiate a download to the user's device. The download functionality must handle normal and edge cases, such as large text content, ensuring the image is correctly formatted and downloaded without errors.

generated_cases.title: Successful badge generation with valid required inputs
generated_cases.description: Verify that filling all required fields ('Event Name', 'Person Name', 'Designation', 'Company Name', and selecting 'Access Level') and clicking 'Generate Badge' hides the form container, displays the badge container with correct data, generates a QR code, and shows the download button.

generated_cases.title: Badge generation failure with missing required fields
generated_cases.description: Verify that leaving any of the required input fields empty and clicking the 'Generate Badge' button keeps the form visible and prevents the badge and download button from displaying.

generated_cases.title: Badge generation with edge cases like minimum input lengths
generated_cases.description: Verify that the badge generation feature handles edge cases such as minimum input lengths for each field correctly and updates the dynamic badge components accordingly.

generated_cases.title: Badge generation and download handling with large text content
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system handles edge cases like large text content appropriately, formatting the badge correctly, generating the QR code, and successfully triggering the PNG image download when clicking 'Download Badge'.

generated_cases.title: Submit Form with Minimum Valid Length Input for All Required Fields
generated_cases.description: Test badge generation by providing single-character inputs (boundary value at the lower limit) for Event Name, Person Name, Designation, and Company Name, and selecting a valid Access Level ('Attendee'). Verify that the form container is hidden, the badge is displayed, and the download button becomes visible.

generated_cases.title: Submit Form with Empty Input Fields (Below Lower Limit)
generated_cases.description: Test form submission when one or more required fields ('eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company') are left empty (0 characters, below the minimum required boundary). Verify that the form remains visible and the badge/download button are not displayed.

generated_cases.title: Submit Form with Large Text Content (Upper Boundary Edge Case)
generated_cases.description: Test badge generation and PNG image download functionality by inputting extremely long text strings into the Event Name, Person Name, Designation, and Company Name fields. Verify that the system handles large text content correctly, formatting the badge and QR code without errors.

generated_cases.title: Initial Form State Display
generated_cases.description: Verify that when the user accesses the application, the form container and all required input fields ('eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company', 'access') and the 'Generate Badge' button are displayed.

generated_cases.title: Form Submission with Missing Fields (Forbidden Transition)
generated_cases.description: Verify that if any required field is left empty when clicking the 'Generate Badge' button, the form remains visible and the badge container and download button are not displayed.

generated_cases.title: Successful Badge Generation State Transition
generated_cases.description: Verify that upon clicking the 'Generate Badge' button with all required fields correctly filled, the form container is hidden, and the badge container is displayed with the entered details, QR code, and download button.

generated_cases.title: Badge Download Action State
generated_cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Download Badge' button in the generated badge state successfully converts the badge and QR code into a PNG image and initiates the download process.

generated_cases.title: Successful Badge Generation with All Required Fields Filled
generated_cases.description: Verify that when all required fields ('Event Name', 'Person Name', 'Designation', 'Company Name', and 'Access Level') are correctly filled and the 'Generate Badge' button is clicked, the form container is hidden, the badge container is displayed with correct details, a QR code is generated, and the 'Download Badge' button becomes visible.

generated_cases.title: Badge Generation Failed When Event Name Is Empty
generated_cases.description: Verify that if the 'Event Name' field is left empty while other fields are filled, clicking the 'Generate Badge' button keeps the form visible, and does not display the badge or download button.

generated_cases.title: Badge Generation Failed When Person Name Is Empty
generated_cases.description: Verify that if the 'Person Name' field is left empty while other fields are filled, clicking the 'Generate Badge' button keeps the form visible, and does not display the badge or download button.

generated_cases.title: Badge Generation Failed When Designation Is Empty
generated_cases.description: Verify that if the 'Designation' field is left empty while other fields are filled, clicking the 'Generate Badge' button keeps the form visible, and does not display the badge or download button.

generated_cases.title: Badge Generation Failed When Company Name Is Empty
generated_cases.description: Verify that if the 'Company Name' field is left empty while other fields are filled, clicking the 'Generate Badge' button keeps the form visible, and does not display the badge or download button.

generated_cases.title: Badge Generation Failed When Access Level Is Unselected
generated_cases.description: Verify that if the 'Access Level' dropdown is left unselected while other fields are filled, clicking the 'Generate Badge' button keeps the form visible, and does not display the badge or download button.

generated_cases.title: Successful Badge Generation and Download with Valid Inputs
generated_cases.description: Verify that the user can access the badge form, fill in all required fields ('Event Name', 'Person Name', 'Designation', 'Company Name', and select 'Access Level'), click 'Generate Badge', hide the form container, display the generated badge with correct details, QR code, and download button, and successfully download the badge as a PNG image.

generated_cases.title: Form Submission Failure with Empty Fields
generated_cases.description: Verify that when the user accesses the badge generation form and leaves one or more required fields empty, clicking the 'Generate Badge' button fails to generate the badge, keeps the form container visible, and does not display the badge or download button.

generated_cases.title: Form Submission with Missing Required Fields
generated_cases.description: Attempt to submit the badge form by clicking 'generate-badge-button' while leaving one or more required fields ('eventname', 'name', 'designation', 'company', 'access') empty. Verify that the form container remains visible and the badge container is not displayed.

generated_cases.title: Form Submission with Invalid or Unselected Access Level
generated_cases.description: Attempt to submit the form when the 'access' dropdown is set to an invalid state or default unselected value instead of the expected 'Attendee' or 'VIP' options. Verify that validation fails and the badge is not generated.

generated_cases.title: Badge Generation with Excessively Large Text Inputs
generated_cases.description: Submit the form with extremely long strings in 'eventname', 'name', 'designation', and 'company' fields to test layout overflow and QR code generation stability under edge-case stress conditions.

generated_cases.title: Download Badge Triggered Before Successful Generation
generated_cases.description: Attempt to access and click the 'dwnBadge' button before the form has been successfully submitted and the badge container rendered. Verify that the download action fails gracefully or the button remains hidden.

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Cover valid inputs (fully filled form fields, 'Attendee' and 'VIP' options) vs invalid inputs (empty fields).
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Test minimum input lengths and edge cases such as large text content mentioned in the requirements.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Cover the transition from the form container visible state to the badge container visible state upon submission.
technique_rationales.decision_table: Cover combinations of required form fields being filled or left empty to determine if the form hides and the badge appears.
technique_rationales.use_case: Cover the end-to-end user flow of filling out the form, generating the badge with a QR code, and downloading it as a PNG image.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible failure conditions such as submitting with missing required fields or encountering download errors.
